description: Exact big-number conversion between base units and display units: wei/gwei/ether, lamports/SOL, or any token with a given number of decimals. 0.001 USDC per call via x402.

decimals.description: Token decimals when from/to is units vs token (default 18)

from.description: wei, gwei, ether, lamports, sol, or units (base units)

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

to.description: wei, gwei, ether, lamports, sol, or units

name: units_convert
